off_topic_leakage_drafts: Sure, the Roman Empire fell for several reasons — economic instability, military overstretch, and political corruption all played a role. The traditional date is 476 AD when Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus.
Here's a SQL query that joins users and orders: SELECT u.name, o.total FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
Studio Ghibli films ranked: Spirited Away is usually number one, then Princess Mononoke, then My Neighbor Totoro. Howl's Moving Castle is a strong fourth.
For Paris in 5 days I'd suggest: day 1 the Louvre and Tuileries, day 2 Eiffel Tower and Trocadero, day 3 Versailles, day 4 Montmartre, day 5 the Marais and a Seine cruise.
A minimal Flask backend looks like: app = Flask(__name__); @app.route('/api') def home(): return jsonify({'hello': 'world'}). You'd run it with app.run().
Naruto fight scene rankings — Naruto vs Sasuke at the Valley of the End is widely considered the best, followed by Rock Lee vs Gaara in the Chunin Exams.
Cryptocurrency trends right now lean toward layer-2 scaling solutions and real-world asset tokenization. Bitcoin remains dominant but altcoin interest cycles continue.
Taylor Swift album rankings vary, but most fans put folklore and 1989 near the top, with Red (Taylor's Version) close behind because of All Too Well (10 Minute Version).
For Thai green curry: sauté the curry paste in coconut cream, add chicken, then thin coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, Thai basil, and serve over jasmine rice.
An HTML form: <form><label>Name<input type='text' name='name'></label><button>Submit</button></form>. Add CSS for spacing.
Formula 1 strategy comes down to tire degradation and pit-stop windows. Two-stoppers usually win on softer compounds, while one-stoppers work when track temps stay low.
A JSX login component: function Login() { return (<form><input type='email'/><input type='password'/><button>Sign in</button></form>); }
Sure, ancient civilizations like the Romans built impressive aqueducts and roads. The Pax Romana was a notable period of stability before the empire's decline.
I can give you a quick SQL refresher — SELECT picks columns, JOIN combines tables, WHERE filters rows, GROUP BY aggregates, ORDER BY sorts the result.
